name: github-issues-example
description: Reads the signed-in GitHub user and the open issues of a repository with the buyer's own GitHub token. An example Agent Plugins package with declarative API actions: no code.

tools.name: get_authenticated_user
tools.description: Use to find out which GitHub account the token belongs to. Returns the account login, name and profile URL. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: list_repository_issues
tools.description: Use to list the open issues of one GitHub repository, newest first. Needs the repository as owner/name. Returns issue numbers, titles, labels and links.

repository.description: The repository as owner/name, for example octocat/hello-world.

credential_slots.label: GitHub token
credential_slots.description: A GitHub personal access token with read access to the repositories you want to read. It is stored encrypted and sent only to api.github.com.
